title: Ten Little Bananas | Fun Counting Kids Song for Toddlers & Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - English
description:
Count one to ten with a cheeky squirrel who keeps sneaking bananas!
This fun rhyme teaches numbers, sharing, and saying sorry when we make a mistake.
Sing along and count with the kids until we reach ten again!

One, two, three, four, five bananas on the plate
Yellow, yellow, yellow, shiny and round
Yum, yum, yum, yum
Let's count them one by one!
Count with me, one to ten, ten little yellow bananas
One, two, three, all in a row
Count, count, count, count
Ten little bananas, hooray!
Six, seven, eight, the squirrel sneaks in
"Tip-toe, tip-toe," he goes
Grab, grab, grab, grab
Oh no! The number's going down!
Count with me, one to ten, ten little yellow bananas
One, two, three, all in a row
Count, count, count, count
Ten little bananas, hooray!
Little sister gasps, "Who's there? Look!"
Brother shouts, "Squirrel, stop!"
Catch, catch, catch, catch
"Sorry, sorry!" says the squirrel
Count with me, one to ten, ten little yellow bananas
One, two, three, all in a row
Count, count, count, count
Ten little bananas, hooray!
Nine for us and one for him
Amma claps, "Share, share, share!"
Ten, ten, ten, ten
Ten again, yay, yay, yay!
